fieldValues.title: Compositions cannot number items or choose what a relation row shows
fieldValues.summary: Minutes are numbered items, but a composition has no numbering; a relation row lists related records by identity only and cannot filter by the type at the other end, so fragments carry a tool-written citation field as their identity and the PDF numbers minutes with CSS.
evidence: Rendered minutes composition: "Transcript: lines 84-95 · Keeping a fire escape assessment document"
Topic rows listed fragments and decision points together under one label
fieldValues.body: Workarounds live in the package (the citation field) and the publisher (CSS counters).
